en.title: Illegal Soccer
en.description: Play soccer without referees using weapons, jetpacks, grappling hooks, and other equipment.
tips: Practice shooting and passing before matches.
Use equipment to create space and regain possession.
Watch for obstacles left by opponents.

pt-BR.title: Illegal Soccer
pt-BR.description: Jogue futebol sem árbitros usando armas, jetpacks, ganchos e outros equipamentos.
tips: Pratique chutes e passes antes das partidas.
Use os equipamentos para criar espaço e recuperar a bola.
Observe os obstáculos deixados pelos adversários.
